title: Comparative performance analysis of ChatGPT, Scholar GPT, and DeepSeek of the Conselho Brasileiro de Oftalmologia 2022 theoretical exams

live_model.id_in_text: ChatGPT (GPT-4-Turbo version, also stated elsewhere as 'version GPT-4.0'); Scholar GPT (GPT-4-Turbo version)
live_model.evidence: 'ChatGPT (version GPT-4.0) and ScholarGPT (version 1.2) were accessed via their official web platforms, operating remotely on the providers' cloud infrastructure'; elsewhere: 'ChatGPT: GPT-4-Turbo version.'

prompt.location: Methods: 'Uniform prompt structures were applied to each question'; models given the uploaded exam PDF and asked for direct answers
prompt.note: Prompt structure described generically; exact wording not printed.

claim.metric: accuracy (%) on CBO 2022 theoretical exams I/II (ChatGPT-specific value not confirmed; only DeepSeek's 97.8%/81.9% is given in the abstract, with ChatGPT stated as 'intermediate')
claim.location: Abstract/Results (46 valid Exam I + 122 valid Exam II questions = 168); DeepSeek numbers given, ChatGPT numeric row not located in excerpt

data.source: Conselho Brasileiro de Oftalmologia 2022 Specialist Certification theoretical exams I/II (proprietary certification exam, uploaded as PDF; not confirmed publicly released)

notes: Models accessed through ChatGPT's and Scholar GPT's web interfaces on a single date (March 2, 2025) rather than the API, and the internal model-version label is inconsistent (GPT-4-Turbo vs. GPT-4.0) so it cannot be pinned to a specific live snapshot. Also relies on a proprietary certification exam.
